subject: error in using conditionalPanel(sliderInput(...)) - shiny 0.2 vs shiny 0.4.0

messages.author: e30f7240ad59e93c
messages.subject: error in using conditionalPanel(sliderInput(...)) - shiny 0.2 vs shiny 0.4.0
parts:
All,

I recently updated to shiny 0.4.0 and have run into a new error running an app built (and working normally) under shiny 0.2. The app runs normally except when I try to use the conditionalPanel(sliderInput(...)). If I do try to use it, I get an error but the app does not crash. Have there been any changes to the use of these tools between versions? Any help would be appreciated.

Any help would be greatly appreciated
